scope: Fixed exploratory comparison of genuine RawNIND Bayer half-resolution iter4350000 and pre-upsample iter4320000, both official UtNet2/in_channels4/funit32/LeakyReLU, strict checkpoint states and original source. Same existing noisy observations, global-ADC camera normalization, signed measurements preserved, input-only CFA-channel LS gains, CPU IEEE FP32/nativeB1/two threads. Reuse V104 exact floats, no new V104 forwards/training/default/selector/frozen-queue changes. Score all original12 material cases and4 paired adverse/batch-partner crops; view same two previously selected adverse camera ROIs and all6 cached GFX512 contexts with fixed displays. GFX ISO100 is an independent qualitative reference, no pixelwise score; AHD camera RGB auxiliary, not exact GT. No new RAW/original-HDD read. Separate source/architecture/training histories; this finite pilot cannot establish a global ranking or speed claim.
